name: tarodan
description: Tarodan - İkinci El Eşya Alım Satım ve Takas Platformu

scripts.start: pnpm run docker:up; pnpm run dev
scripts.dev:restart: lsof -ti:3000 -ti:3001 -ti:3002 2>/dev/null | xargs kill -9 2>/dev/null; sleep 2; pnpm dev
scripts.dev:env: [ -f apps/api/.env ] || cp apps/api/env.example.txt apps/api/.env; [ -f apps/web/.env.local ] || cp apps/web/env.example.txt apps/web/.env.local; [ -f apps/admin/.env.local ] || cp apps/admin/env.example.txt apps/admin/.env.local
scripts.dev:up: docker compose -f infrastructure/docker-compose.yml up -d && docker compose -f infrastructure/docker-compose.yml up -d --wait postgres redis
scripts.dev:urls:
printf '
✅ Altyapı hazır — uygulamalar başlıyor:
   Web     http://localhost:3000
   API     http://localhost:3001  (health: http://localhost:3001/api/health)
   Admin   http://localhost:3002
   Mailhog http://localhost:8025 · Kibana http://localhost:5601
   Durdurmak için: Ctrl+C + pnpm dev:stop

'
scripts.dev:local: pnpm dev:env && pnpm dev:up && pnpm db:migrate:deploy && pnpm db:generate && pnpm dev:types && pnpm dev:urls && turbo run dev --filter=@tarodan/web --filter=@tarodan/admin --filter=@tarodan/api --filter=@tarodan/types
scripts.dev:reset: pnpm dev:env && pnpm dev:up && pnpm db:reset && pnpm db:generate && turbo run dev --filter=@tarodan/web --filter=@tarodan/admin --filter=@tarodan/api --filter=@tarodan/types
scripts.dev:stop: lsof -ti:3000 -ti:3001 -ti:3002 2>/dev/null | xargs kill -9 2>/dev/null; docker compose -f infrastructure/docker-compose.yml down
scripts.stack:up: pnpm docker:up && pnpm pm2:start && echo '\n✅ Tarodan stack ayağa kalktı: http://localhost:3000 (web), http://localhost:3001 (api), http://localhost:5601 (kibana), http://localhost:8025 (mailhog)'
scripts.stack:status: pnpm pm2:status && docker compose -f infrastructure/docker-compose.yml ps
